component.name: SOCKS
component.summary: Tesla companion for Linux: Bluetooth control, charge status, driving and charging history

description.p: SOCKS for your Tesla. SOCKS stands for State Of Charge, Keys and Stats: SoC is what battery engineers call the state of charge, the one number every EV app revolves around, plus the two other things the app does. Hence the sock with a lightning bolt.
It is a lean, fast desktop companion for your Tesla. It talks to the car directly over Bluetooth and, if you choose, through the Tesla Fleet API.

See charge level, range and charging state, lock and unlock, control climate and the charge port, and keep a local history of kilometres driven, charging sessions, efficiency and battery health. Everything is stored on your computer. There is no telemetry.
